variants.name: c-10-verification
variants.description: Deterministic and rendered validation receipt for the responsive UAR application shell

notes: The integrated shell was rendered in the in-app browser at 1440, 901, 900, 390, and 320 CSS pixels.

The rendered audit measured a 240px expanded rail, 60px collapsed rail, the exact 900px presentation switch, four 44px compact targets, one main landmark, a 3px ember focus outline, and zero horizontal overflow.
The Base UI command palette and Configure sheet were visually inspected and exercised through navigation.
Frontend typecheck, lint, boundaries, Flat 2.0, 28 focused tests, and strict OpenSpec validation pass.

The first isolated review passed with no critical findings; its actionable keyboard, dialog-stacking, breadcrumb, current-state, favicon, manifest, and design-artifact findings were remediated and covered before the final review round.
The second isolated review found a critical duplicate-current-route defect in the broad /admin matcher; exact root matching and a one-current-link assertion now close it.
The route-corrected review passed with no critical findings; its shortcut-toggle, modal-scope, and PWA-size polish items were applied before the final receipt.

The next isolated review exposed incorrect favicon precedence; the fallback now precedes media-specific choices, and all concrete typography, editable-target, breakpoint-modal, announcement, duplicate-download, and shortcut-label findings are resolved.

Expected local API proxy failures were excluded from console validation because the backend was intentionally not running; the application correctly projected the resulting Unreachable readiness state.
Full frontend tests and production build remain deferred to the Wave 4 boundary after C-12 under the repository tier contract.
